characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

After determining Deployment Zones (at the end of step 6 of the Pre-Game Sequence), you may choose a single Field, Ruins, or Forest Terrain Feature that becomes Water Terrain. In addition, while the model is on the Battlefield, all Water Terrain Features on the Battlefield are considered Dangerous Terrain (1) for all models.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

At Initiative Step 10, all other units (friend and foe) Engaged in the same Combat as the model suffer D6+1 hits with Toxic Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Heavy Armour and Scoring.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Extra Support (2), Hard Target (1), Light Troops and Skirmisher. In addition, enemy models that are not immune to the effects of Fear in units in base contact with one or more models with Corsair Ravagers suffer -1 Discipline.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model part gains +2 Attack Value and its Special Item allowance is increased by 100 pts. In addition, the army may modify the roll for choosing Deployment Zones by -1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains +2 Health Points, 2 additional Lashmasters, and its base size is changed to 100×150 SI.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model cannot join units that contain another model from the same unit entry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The attack gains +1 to wound. Attacks with Artistry of Death lose Ruthless Efficiency if they had it.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

At step 8 of the Pre-Game Sequence (after Spell Selection), the owner must choose one of the following options and apply its effect to all models with Captain's Orders in the army:
  • Give no Quarter: The model gains Scoring.
  • Loot and Pillage: The model gains Light Troops.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model’s unit gains Coastal Predator and Devastating Charge (Lethal Strike).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model can select its spells from all the Learned Spells of its chosen Path and the Hereditary Spell. This rule overrides the Spell Selection rules connected to being a Wizard Adept.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Enemy units within 8" of one or more Sea-Fog Leviathans suffer -1 to hit for Shooting Attacks. In addition, the duration of Shrouded by Mist is extended until the end of the second Game Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Combat Reform Tests and March Tests of enemy units within 8" of one or more models with Siren's Song suffer -2 Discipline.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Dispelling rolls against spells cast by the model suffer a -2 Dispelling Modifier if the Casting Attempt was performed with 4 or more Magic Dice.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

If the model is the General, Discipline Tests using its Commanding Presence suffer -1 Discipline.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Strider (Water Terrain). In addition, units gain Devastating Charge (+2" Adv) and Hard Target~(1) while both the following conditions are met:

  • More than half of their models have Coastal Predator.

  • More than half of their models have the centre of their base inside a Water Terrain Feature.


Characters without Coastal Predator that Charge out of a unit do not benefit from Coastal Predator.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The number of models with Terrors of the Deep in the army is restricted to 1 per 1500 Army Points, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: At the start of each Round of Combat that the model’s unit is fighting, each unit with one or more models with Barbed Nets must choose one enemy unit in base contact and roll a D6. On 2+, the chosen unit is Netted. Units Netted one or more times suffer -1 Strength and -1 Armour Penetration until the end of the Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The attack gains +1 to wound during the First Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 12", Shots X, Str 3, AP 0, Accurate, Quick to Fire. When shooting from Short Range, the weapon gains +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Apply the following rules during the first Game Turn:


  • For Shooting Attacks made against units that are more than 12" away, all units (friend and foe) are considered to be in Soft Cover.

  • Charge Range rolls made against units that are more than 12" away are subject to Minimised Roll unless more than half of the Charging unit’s models have Coastal Predator.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The target may immediately perform a 12" Magical Move and loses Scoring. {In addition, the target gains Coastal Predator.}

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain +2 Armour Penetration. While using this weapon, the wielder gains +2 Attack Value and Fear.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 18", Shots 2D6. Shooting Attacks of units that are hit by one or more attacks made with this weapon suffer -1 to hit until the end of the next Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer can cast Tempest of the Storm Witch (Hereditary Spell) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Magic Resistance (2) and Hard Target (1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. The owner may activate this Artefact at the end of any friendly Movement Phase and place a Water Terrain Feature in contact with the bearer and at least 1" away from any enemy units and other Terrain Features. The Water Terrain must fit within a circle with a diameter of 6".

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit gains Fear, and while in base contact with the bearer's unit, enemy units gain Maximised (Fear Tests). In addition, friendly units Engaged in the same Combat as the bearer's unit must reroll natural to-wound rolls of '1'.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s unit gains Feigned Flight.
